subject.title: fix(sweep): allow PR review lease comments

question: Should the scheduled review shard receive pull-request write directly after verifying token isolation, or should PR lease/status mutation be moved behind a separate deterministic comment token?
rationale: The permission is necessary for the reported workflow but expands the mutation authority of a token used by the review-shard process, so repository owners must confirm the intended credential boundary.

options.title: Verify and grant the scope
options.body: Confirm the App installation permission and that Codex receives only the read-only inspection token, then merge and prove the live comment path.

options.title: Split the mutation token
options.body: Mint a separate short-lived pull-request-write token used only by deterministic lease/status helpers, keeping the broader review process read-only.

options.title: Pause the rollout
options.body: Do not merge until the ClawHub installation can be reauthorized and a safe live verification window is available.

recommendation.title: Verify and grant the scope
recommendation.body: Confirm the App installation permission and that Codex receives only the read-only inspection token, then merge and prove the live comment path.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the most direct evidence from the failing production run and the adjacent recovery workflow, though final credential-boundary approval remains with repository owners.
